4. **Recovery**: No errors or empty results; straightforward case.
There are no explicit constraints to check, and Adventure feels like a fair read of "sweeping and exploratory." The final proposal has the right schema fields (channelName, rationale, picks with mediaType/tmdbId/name/rationale, confidence 0.91, policy), and the pick traces back to the tool result.
